findings.quote: write the total distance covered from rest of motion up to n seconds using the standard distance equation
findings.note: The phrase "from rest of motion" is not readable English, and taken literally it states a condition the question does not have, since the object starts with initial velocity u rather than from rest. The equation printed below it correctly keeps the un term.
findings.fix: write the total distance covered from the start of the motion up to n seconds using the standard distance equation
